title: Thai-Style Chicken Satay
description: A classic Southeast Asian dish featuring marinated chicken grilled to perfection on skewers, served with a zesty peanut sauce.

ingredients.name: chili peppers
ingredients.notes: such as Thai bird's eye chilies

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together peanut sauce, chili peppers, garlic, ginger, and coconut milk.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix until well coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with peanut oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the satay for 8-10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve immediately with additional peanut sauce for dipping.
Optional: serve with steamed vegetables or a side of sticky rice.
